title: α-Rank: Multi-Agent Evaluation by Evolution
reasoning: The paper introduces a novel game-theoretic solution concept and a methodology (α-Rank) for evaluating and ranking agents in multi-agent interactions, primarily in the context of empirical game theory. It does not discuss religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethics as a core component of its evaluation or benchmarking.
